clauses.quote: Developing and providing inservice training for Panel members and Consulting Teachers shall be done jointly by the Association and the District
clauses.subject_text: Developing and providing inservice training for Panel members and Consulting Teachers
clauses.notes: Joint obligation on the District and Association.

clauses.quote: The Panel, based upon extenuating circumstances, may recommend to the Board of Education through the Superintendent an extension of this period of time.
clauses.notes: Discretionary panel authority regarding PAR program extension.

clauses.quote: All panel proceedings and materials related to personal matters shall be confidential.
clauses.subject_text: All panel proceedings and materials related to personal matters
clauses.notes: Duty of confidentiality imposed on management.
